# Perlego

> Perlego is an online academic ebook subscription platform providing access to 1M+ textbooks and research materials with AI-powered Smart Search for students and institutions.

Perlego offers flexible subscription plans for individual students and institutional access for universities and colleges across multiple languages including English, German, Spanish, French, and Italian. The platform features comprehensive subject coverage from STEM to humanities with advanced discovery and search capabilities.

## Key Topics

- academic subscription
- digital library
- Smart Search
- AI-powered index
- textbook access
- book discovery
- institutional access
- academic resources
- student learning

- student resources

## Getting Started

- [Perlego | An online subscription for all your academic books](https://www.perlego.com): Perlego homepage: subscription service for 1M+ academic ebooks with Smart Search
- [Pricing | Perlego](https://www.perlego.com/pricing): Perlego subscription plans with flexible monthly and annual billing options
- [Institutions - Access for Universities & Colleges | Perlego](https://www.perlego.com/institutions): Institutional access solution for universities and colleges via Perlego
